item.description:
# Weft 1.0.5
- Discover multiple Node workspace services from package.json or pnpm-workspace.yaml, including Storybook and build watchers. Follow declared workspace dependencies and avoid starting a duplicate root orchestration command. - Detect multiple Swift executable products and Python project entry points as separate services. - Add a visible Restart control beside each running service. - Add Build/Rebuild controls for services with declared build commands, with live progress, errors, and the last successful build time. - Pause only the service being built and restore it after success, leaving other services running. - Add Pattern UI dist and static Storybook build commands to the Pattern Pi recipe.
Live updates were checked in isolated copies using the repository's Storybook and Pi Vite configurations: a shared source edit appeared in both browser pages without restarting servers or reloading the documents. Live updates remain provided by each repository's development commands.
